Capability: Composes the desktop workspace shell: toolbar, stage rail, tab strip, table/tree pane, 3D canvas, inspector, section pages, agent strip and status bar, mounting sections lazily on first visit.
Notes: Composition root only; the shell pieces themselves live under src/features (outside this area). App.tsx re-exports solve gates and persistence helpers for tests. Helpers isBlankAuthoringModel, countStatus and operationIntentDisplayRef are defined but never called (dead).

Capability: Provides an in-page application menu bar (File, Edit, View, Insert, Analyze) with enabled/checked states and visible disabled reasons, shown only when not running inside the native shell.
Notes: Suppressed in the packaged app, where the OS menu replaces it. Menu item catalogue and command sink are in src/features/workspace (outside this area).

Capability: Adds view, stage, theme and density switching commands to the command palette with the same states and reasons as the View menu.
Notes: Exists so the native runtime, whose OS menu lacks these items, still has a pointer route to them.

Capability: Builds the native macOS menu bar and forwards each menu choice to the web view as a DOM event for the shared command handler.
Notes: Listener side is in src/features/workspace/workspaceSession.ts (outside this area). services/nativeMenu.ts::listenToNativeMenu has no callers and listens on a different event name than the native side emits (dead).

Capability: Synchronises native window title (project name and edited marker) and native menu checked/enabled states with the app, disabling project commands while busy.
Notes: No-op in the browser preview.

Capability: Packages the product as a macOS desktop app: window size limits, bundle identity, icons, dev/build hooks, plugin wiring and linked engine crates.
Notes: Content security policy is set to null (disabled). Icons are produced by a release tool outside this area. SWBPIPE_logo.png is not referenced by any tracked file.

Capability: Runs a packaged-binary self-test from a command-line flag that saves an edited load in a disposable store, reopens it and solves it, printing evidence.
Notes: Store is removed before returning.

Capability: Loads the invented preview model and design-knowledge fixtures at startup, natively from the fixtures folder or from bundled copies in the browser.
Notes: Native lookup tries paths relative to the process working directory; on failure the frontend silently falls back to the bundled fixture.

Capability: Solves the current model for preview mechanics in a sparse or dense solver mode through the linked physics engine; in the browser only the unedited fixture returns a result.
Notes: Browser mode returns a MODEL_INCOMPLETE result for any edited model rather than solving. The modeless run_preview_mechanics command is registered but not called by the frontend.

Capability: Runs a solve as a background job that the UI can poll and cancel with a token; cancellation is cooperative at checkpoints and a cancelled result is discarded.
Notes: Not preemptive. Browser preview reports that no backend job exists. Modeless start command is registered but unused by the frontend.

Capability: Assigns each solver result row its canonical physical dimension from its kind and component, rejecting rows whose declared dimension disagrees or is undeclared.
Notes: Hard-coded kind table; a new result kind fails loudly until added.

Capability: Builds and verifies the hash-bound analysis-run record (version 0.2) for a solve, composing the input manifest, semantic contract and any recognised rule-check aggregate.
Notes: Unrecognised aggregates fall back to the solve's own rule-check status. Reads a semantic contract fixture from the fixtures folder.

Capability: Compares solver results between two load bases and reports matched pairs and unmatched rows as diagnostics.
Notes: Default bases are fixture-specific identifiers; other models get no pairs unless the caller passes bases.

Capability: Builds and verifies a canonical, hashed manifest of the current session's inputs (model, solver identity, rule packs, external assets) for binding results and exports.
Generates a sample review-only agent proposal from a mechanics result and selected target without changing the model.
Notes: Browser falls back to a fixture-backed proposal. Not a live model provider.

Capability: Shows the design-agent workbench: selection, target, queue and boundary facts with Run, Propose, Review and Inspect actions and the active proposal summary.
Notes: Status text is a fixed sentence saying a packaged human pass and exit review are not recorded, varying only on whether a solve, rule-check and saved project exist.

Capability: Hosts the Operations section tabs (review, geometry, supports, self weight, agent, details), including stored proposed context that can be requeued for fresh validation.
Notes: Tab panels are feature components outside this area; this row covers the tab host and the retained-context requeue list defined inline.

Capability: Lets the user resize the table/canvas split and the table drawer by pointer or keyboard, close the inspector, and use slide-over drawers in narrow windows.
Notes: Handlers are provided by the workspace session in src/features (outside this area).

Capability: Validates or applies one model edit operation against a claimed model hash, natively through the operation engine crate or in the browser through its wasm build.
Notes: Includes engine warm-up status reporting.

Capability: Validates or applies an ordered batch of model operations atomically against a claimed model hash, natively or through the wasm engine.
Generates a reviewable self-weight load operation plan for selected pipes, natively or through a separate self-weight wasm engine.
Notes: Absent wasm asset fails with a named diagnostic.

Capability: Loads the wasm build of the operation engine in the browser and fails with a named diagnostic and build command when the asset is missing, with no fallback engine.
Notes: Unit test setup pre-loads the engine, so unit suites require a prior wasm build.

Capability: Builds both wasm engines with a pinned binding generator into the served public folder, writing atomically and failing with exact remediation steps.
Notes: Generated output is not committed.

Capability: Configures the frontend build and unit tests, and fails a production build when wasm engine assets are missing from input or output.
Notes: Also sets vendor chunk splitting and 30 s unit-test timeouts.

Capability: Computes canonical JSON and SHA-256 hashes (including a checked profile) for models, project envelopes and export packages through the engine's wasm build.
Notes: No TypeScript fallback hashing. usePackageHash hook has no direct test.

Capability: Converts quantities between units for display, natively or through the wasm engine, surfacing engine errors.
Publishes the accepted unit catalogue with dimensions, transform kinds and provenance, and lets the UI look up units, describe unit basis and check dimension match.
Formats a value in inches or feet with an approximate metric equivalent for display.
Notes: No product caller found; appears dead.

Capability: Reports local storage capability: bundled SQLite, full-text search availability, no network, daemon or telemetry, path policy and store migration status.
Migrates the local SQLite store schema through ordered versions (projects, review columns, hashes, migration ledger, rule packs, libraries) and records migration evidence.
Notes: Target schema version 11.

Capability: Carries a project store forward from the app's former data folder on first launch by a consistent SQLite copy, never modifying the old store or overwriting a new one.
Creates, opens (latest or by id), lists and saves local projects, persisting the model with review context, results, analysis run and integrity hashes.
Notes: Browser preview keeps a single in-memory snapshot instead of a store.

Capability: Offers Project page controls to create, start blank, open, list and save local projects, open a listed project by id, and read the project message and review-context summary.
Creates a blank local model document that is deliberately incomplete, with no fixture entities, hidden loads or engineering defaults.
Evaluates model-document schema versions, migrates older documents in memory, refuses newer or unsupported ones, and records a ledger with pre/post hashes on save.
Notes: Browser side mirrors the native chain; the only migration is a no-op version stamp.

Capability: Computes model and project-envelope hashes when a project is saved and reports whether stored hashes still match when it is reopened.
Notes: Integrity display is in feature panels outside this area.

Capability: Validates a rule-pack document and computes or stamps its document checksum.
Notes: Desktop only; browser preview reports an unavailable route.

Capability: Saves, opens, lists and deletes user rule packs per project in the local store, allowing drafts with findings to be kept.
Notes: Desktop only.

Capability: Provides a starting draft rule-pack document with placeholder provenance for user authoring.
Notes: Placeholder content only; carries no protected values.

Capability: Runs a user rule pack's checks against a solved model, binding solver results, user values and private-library values, and returns only incomplete, checked or failed statuses.
Notes: Unresolvable bindings block rather than pass. Private values are read at run time, not embedded in packs. Desktop only.

Capability: Derives which solver results, user values and library values a rule pack needs, classifies solver-result references, and loads a demo pack.
Validates a material, section, component or hanger library import, classifying it as accepted, rejected or quarantined with findings and a boundary notice.
Notes: Desktop only.

Capability: Refuses to store a library import unless validation accepted it as private local-only data; rejected or suspected-protected imports are never written.
Saves, opens, lists and deletes accepted private libraries per project in the local store.
Notes: Desktop only.

Capability: Supplies an invented library import template and indexes library records and slots to classify whether a library reference resolves.
Notes: Template values are invented.

Capability: Renders the hash-bound calculation report from controlled input through the linked report renderer.
Notes: Desktop only; browser preview reports no renderer. Uncontrolled input is refused before invoking.

Capability: Saves a report package file after checking redaction and local-first evidence, assembling it with the linked solver identity and a native save dialog.
Notes: Browser build fails honestly with no package. Also reachable from the native File menu.

Capability: Writes a file atomically through a temporary sibling, flush, sync and rename, rejecting symlink destinations and reporting bounded directory-sync outcomes.
Notes: Path containment is best effort and does not resist a malicious concurrent swap, as the code states.

Capability: Saves exact result or stress-neutral JSON bytes to the Downloads folder after screening and local-first checks, one save at a time, never overwriting a file.
Notes: Frontend caller is src/features/result-export/nativeResultSave.ts (outside this area). Admission evidence is defence in depth, not authentication.

Capability: Keeps desktop telemetry disabled, dropping any attempt and rejecting attempts that name forbidden fields, surfaces, payloads or transports.
Notes: No telemetry transport exists.

Capability: Shows the audit and boundaries drawer and evidence section: data-boundary policies, local storage status, solve identity pill and audit panels.
Notes: Contained panels are feature components outside this area.

Capability: Shows the issues drawer listing operation diagnostics, model diagnostics and missing required inputs, and computes the issue count shown in the shell.
Defines the product's visual tokens and global styling, generating light, system-dark and dark CSS variable sets from a copied design-system token file.
Notes: Token file and generated CSS are not hand-edited; a test pins the token file hash.

Capability: Declares the frontend types for models, results, analysis runs, operations, proposals and project envelopes, plus an ambient type for the orbit camera control.
Notes: Type-only; enforced by the TypeScript build.

Capability: Prepares unit tests (DOM matchers, wasm engine warm-up) and provides helpers for choosing targets in virtual pickers.
Runs browser end-to-end tests in two lanes: a dev-server lane at two window sizes and a lane against the built production bundle.
Notes: Worker count is capped under CI or by environment.

Capability: Exercises end-to-end user journeys: fixture solve and results, report, from-blank authoring, rule-pack, library and rule-check flows, warnings and boundaries.
Checks table editing, section and material editing, undo/redo and save/open session status end to end.
Checks keyboard focus, Escape ownership, disabled-reason visibility and accessibility-tree exclusion end to end.
Checks viewport hide, isolate, dim and show-all behaviour and its independence from model history and results end to end.
Checks workspace layout, pane sizes, selection, tree, properties and canvas regressions across themes, densities and window sizes in dev and production builds.
Notes: Uses the generated large fixtures below.

Capability: Checks the built production bundle serves the wasm engine, carries result packages, applies self-weight batches and fails report packaging honestly in the browser.
Notes: The native asset protocol hop is not reachable from a browser.

Capability: Runs an opt-in UI performance benchmark of the production bundle: instrumented sessions, point and box selection timing, resource use and supervised baseline/candidate runs.
Notes: Not discovered by ordinary e2e runs. Partial or focused runs are stated not to be qualification.

Capability: Measures causal frame presentation from browser traces and scores results against performance targets, with a full-cohort controller and a separate characterization mode.
Notes: Compositor observations are not proof of physical display output.

Capability: Provides independent hit oracles that predict which entity a canvas point or box gesture should select, with verifiers and a frozen candidate point oracle.
Holds deterministic generated UI workloads (1,000 and 10,000 pipe models, deformation overlays, precision-origin cases), interaction samples and point oracles, with generator and verifier.
Notes: Invented values only; the generator has a check mode that reproduces the frozen files.

Capability: Documents how to run the UI foundation fixtures and benchmark, a repair record for its first profile, the observer boundary, and frozen qualification and control-binding contracts.
Notes: Contract JSON files are marked frozen or pending and reference governance material outside this area.

Capability: Gives a manual desktop smoke checklist over invented preview data and a long running log of per-change smoke notes.
Notes: Early checks name a former product header and fixture strings that may no longer match the current shell.
